display_name: Proxis (AI email agent — soft outbound gate)
subcategory: application-layer email agent w/ confidence-gated auto-send (boundary)
install_tell: Enterprise AI email agent: auto-drafts/auto-sends in the user's tone from CRM/Slack context, with a confidence-based hold-for-review. YC S2024, funding undisclosed. proxis.ai.
misconfig_patterns: Boundary case: Proxis is a PRODUCER of mail with a self-gate (confidence threshold), not a guardrail layer sitting between an arbitrary agent and the recipient. Cataloged as boundary/app-layer, not category-core.

active_probe.false_positive_check: proxis.ai apex + 'email agent'; 'proxis' is otherwise generic.

deployment_tells: App-layer; rides a substrate; CRM/Slack context ingestion.
pivot_paths: Self-gate (confidence-hold) is the only safety primitive; classify as soft outbound gate, not a guardrail.

competitive_lane.lane: application-layer email agent; soft outbound gate (confidence-hold), not a guardrail
competitive_lane.differentiator: Mail producer with a self-review threshold rather than an interposed safety layer.
